निंज् {c2c} A. (निंक्ते) To wash. --WITH
प्र to wash (प्रणिंक्ते).

निनंक्षु a.
1 Wishing to die.
--2
Wishing to escape or fly away;

.
--2
Buzzing, humming (of bees &c.).
--3 A
sound like that of a chariot.

.
--2
Buzzing, humming (of bees &c.).
--3 A
sound like that of a chariot.

निनादित n. Filled with noise,
resounding, made to sound.
--तं A
sound.

निनादिन् a.
1 Sounding, ringing.
--2 Causing to sound, playing (as a
musical instrument).

To sound.
--2 To
prolong a note (in chanting).

निनर्दः Prolonging a note in
chanting.

निनाह्यः A water-jar to be put
into the ground.

To take near or
towards, carry near, bring, fetch;

.
--2 To bend, incline; वक्त्रं
निनीय.
--3 To pour down.
--4 To
bring about, accomplish, perform.
--5 To spend (time).

निनृत्त a. Repeated(as a portion
of a verse.)

निंद् {c1c} P. (निंदति, निंदितः प्रणिंदति)
To blame, censure, find fault with,
revile, reproach, condemn; निनिंद रूपं
हृदयेन पार्वती

; सा निंदंती
स्वानि भाग्यानि बाला Ś. 5. 30;

निंदक a. [निंद्-वुञ्] Blaming,
censuring, abusing, defaming.

निंदनं, निंदा [निंद्-भावे-ल्युट् अ वा]
1
Blame, censure, reproof, reproach,
abuse, reviling, defamation;
व्याजस्तुतिर्मुखे निंदा K.

; पर˚, वेद˚.
--2
Injury, wickedness.
--Comp.
--स्तुतिः
f. {1} ironical praise, irony. {2}
overt praise.

निंदनं, निंदा [निंद्-भावे-ल्युट् अ वा]

--2
Injury, wickedness.
--Comp.
--स्तुतिः
f. {1} ironical praise, irony. {2}
overt praise.

निंदित p. p. [निंद्-क्त]
1 Blamed,
censured, abused, defamed &c.
--2
Low, despicable.
--3 Prohibited,
forbidden.

निंद्य a.
1 Blamable, censurable,
reprehensible, bad, vile.
--2
Forbidden, prohibited.

निंदुः f. A woman bearing a dead
child.

निंबः A tree with bitter fruits;
आम्रं छित्त्वा कुठारेण निंबं परिचरेत्तु यः ।
यश्चैनं पयसा सिंचेन्नैवास्य मधुरो भवेत् ॥
Rām.
--Comp.
--तरुः {1} the Mandāra
tree. {2} the Nimba tree.
निंबू f. A kind of जंबीर (lime).
